text:
mike: Heads up — getting capacity alerts for ap-southeast1. Lots of small gpu pods pending on rack-12 while rack-9 sits ~60% idle. Any recent topology changes?

eva: :eyes: saw similar yesterday, thought it was affinity churn after the label rollout.

sre-jen: can you paste a couple pod specs? curious about nodeAffinity + topologySpread usage.

mike: quick dump:```kubectl get pod ml-infer-*-0 -o yaml | sed -n '1,120p'``` shows nodeAffinity requiring gpu-type: a100 and topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone with preferredDuringScheduling.

sam: that topology key + preferredDuringScheduling can still lead to rack hotspots if the scheduler prefers AZ placement but we've uneven GPU flavors across racks.

eva: I think rack-12 has all the a100s after last provisioning, rack-9 is a mixed GPU rack but advertises a100 via a label that only some nodes actually have (label drift).

sre-jen: label drift — ugh. ops-bot, can you run node inventory check?

ops-bot: Running inventory check...
ops-bot: Result: 8 nodes in ap-southeast1-rack-9 labeled gpu=a100 but 3 report model=rtx8000.

mike: confirms label drift. That explains scheduler picking rack-12 due to more matching nodes. But why are pods stuck pending instead of getting scheduled on r9 where some nodes match?

sam: could be pod anti-affinity or taints on the r9 nodes, or kube-scheduler scoring penalizing cross-rack due to topologySpread constraints. Also check if there are ephemeral reservations (warm pools) pinned to certain racks.

eva: I also saw conntrack errors in kube-proxy logs on r9 earlier, could be intermittent network causing periodic NotReady status and the scheduler marking nodes as unschedulable briefly. Pods then queue up during bounce.

sre-jen: action items: 1) run node label reconcile to fix gpu label drift (temporary fix); 2) audit taints/affinities on r9; 3) check warm-pool reservations pinned to rack-12. Anyone take 1?

mike: I'll run label reconcile now (one-off). Doing:```kubectl label node node-09-03 gpu=a100 --overwrite```

mike: done for 3 nodes. Re-run scheduler probe.

ops-bot: Pod ml-infer-21 rescheduled to node-09-03, status Running.

sam: nice. Still want a longer term: need a reconciliation job to detect label drift + alert, and consider relaxing topologySpread for tiny pods to reduce fragmentation.

eva: agree. Also proposal: add a probe to autoscaler to prefer spreading across racks when provisioning new capacity (avoid filling one rack).

sre-jen: +1. I'll open an issue with proposed tasks and assign owners: label-reconcile (mike), warmpool-audit (sam), autoscaler-spread-proposal (eva).

mike: noted. Thanks all. Closing thread once issue/PR created. :thumbsup:
